SUBJECT: an outer sea gate built as a plain twentieth-century poured-concrete sluice housing. Two blunt rectangular concrete piers frame a heavy flat steel door leaf that slides vertically in a recessed guide channel. Above the leaf an exposed steel winch deck: a geared hoist drum, a lift chain hanging straight down into the guide channel, a maintenance walkway of flat steel grating with a simple pipe handrail. A large valve wheel and round pressure dials are mounted on the pier wall, brine conduits climb the concrete with a white salt ring at every coupling, black water moves below the door sill. Behind the piers only empty overcast sky and a flat low seawall mass. Uninhabited scene, no people, no birds. 

STYLE: painterly semi-realistic game concept art for a quiet maritime-industrial mystery set in a fictional Korean port town at night. Palette strictly limited to deep ink #0E1F26, seal ink #173238, wet-metal blue-grey #36565C, verdigris bronze #4F7A6B, wet-concrete grey #8A8E88, salt-crystal pale cyan #C8D6D3, records-paper warm off-white #E7E3D8, and one single ochre accent #E2AF62 covering less than eight percent of the frame. Overcast night lighting from scattered low work lamps, low contrast, soft diffuse falloff; every frame shows a dark core, a mid range and a bright range. Materials applied literally: salt crystal grows as fine hexagonal clusters at edges with matte scatter; corroded bronze is a dark base with verdigris speckle and run marks that always flow downward; wet concrete is twenty percent darker than dry concrete with a hard horizontal tide line; brine conduits are even cylinders with a white salt ring at every coupling and round analog gauges.

CAMERA: a fixed 2.5D observation node, 35mm equivalent lens, no barrel distortion, eye height 1.55 meters, pitch eighteen degrees downward, zero roll, no dutch angle. The horizontal water line sits in the upper 38 to 44 percent band of the frame. Large horizontal masses, low ceilings, round gauges, architecture older than the people in it.

NEGATIVE: no castle, no fortress, no battlements, no crenellations, no turrets, no watchtower, no stone arch, no arched bridge, no viaduct, no aqueduct, no masonry blockwork, no medieval or european-fantasy architecture, no cathedral shapes, no ornament, no text, no letters, no words, no numbers, no captions, no signage, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no signature, no laurel wreath, no award badge, no user-interface, no real-world disaster photography, no weapons, no combat, no blood, no corpses, no ghosts, no apparitions, no supernatural glow, no anime style, no glossy CGI render, no neon, no lens flare, no bloom, no red warning lights, no chrome, no brand marks.
